apk.notes: Scan Cards on the phone (a photo of the cards → Incoming Product lines; a shop owner sets it up in Settings → Card Scanner with the shop's Ximilar key). Description 1 is now the card name and number ("Charizard ex 223/197") and Description 2 the set, for Upload TCG Player CSV, pasting TCGplayer columns and Scan Cards alike.

web.notes: Report a Problem: tell us when something isn't working. On the computer it's the button at the top right; on the phone it's at the top of Settings. If something goes wrong unexpectedly, a red bar offers Report This.
